about: qm-c4-told-live-2026-11 (QM M1): gbrain as QM's memory on the C4 told-live tasks, Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol (per-cell tables, the paired gbrain comparison, the provider-aware mechanism counts, the preregistered C4 analysis, the notebook exposure count and the commit-binding check).

steps.note: The run's own analysis script, run from the scratch copy because it writes its output beside itself; the scratch copy sits at the same folder depth as the committed one, so its relative imports resolve to the same repository files.

not_rebuilt.what: results/miscount-check/ (check.txt, summarize.out and mechanism.out, the keyless miscount gate)
not_rebuilt.reason: It is a bash script (verify runs only bun and python3 steps) that writes into the committed results folder by a fixed path and stamps the checkout's commit id into check.txt; its numbers are summarize-run and mechanism.ts run over one memory-provider trial, the same scripts this recipe checks over every trial.

not_rebuilt.what: results/smoke-checks.json (the smoke conditions the report quotes in section 7)
not_rebuilt.reason: It was read from each shard's smoke results folder on the controller machine, and those smoke trial folders were never committed (only their trials.jsonl and usage lines were).

not_rebuilt.what: results/qm-opus.ledger-summary.txt, qm-sol.ledger-summary.txt and the two smoke ledger summaries (the spend table in section 13)
not_rebuilt.reason: No script in the repository writes this format; each is a one-off query of a shard's ledger.sqlite, so there is no command to rebuild it with.

rebuild_only.reason: compare-run.ts gained the stats_kit field (which stats kit computed the comparison) in commit 26db539998 (2026-11-05); the published file was written by an earlier version of the script.
summarize-run.ts gained the headroom section (how many tasks can tell the arms apart) in commit 5ddc1a40b2 (2026-11-09); the published file was written by an earlier version of the script.
